title: DiscordInvite
description: Command (/discord) displays a clickable Discord invite link to players.
body:
# DiscordInvite Plugin

A simple, lightweight Minecraft plugin that displays a clickable Discord invite link to players.

## Features
- ✅ Works on Minecraft 1.21.x
- ✅ Folia compatible
- ✅ Clickable Discord link in chat
- ✅ Fully configurable colors and messages
- ✅ Hot-reload configuration without server restart
- ✅ Permission-based reload command

## Commands
- `/discord` or `/dc` - Shows the clickable Discord link
- `/discordreload` or `/dcr` - Reloads the plugin configuration (OP/Console only)

## Permissions
- `discordinvite.reload` - Allows reloading the configuration (default: OP)

## Installation
1. Download or build the plugin JAR file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server or load the plugin
4. Edit `plugins/DiscordInvite/config.yml` to customize
5. Use `/discordreload` to apply changes

## Configuration
Edit `config.yml` to customize:
- Discord invite URL
- Message text and color
- Hover text and color
